source.inspectionDescription: Reports inner classes that can be made 'static'. A 'static' inner class does not keep an implicit reference to its enclosing instance. When using Java 17 or before, this prevents a common cause of memory leaks and uses less memory per instance of the class. Inspection ID: InnerClassMayBeStatic
